g.text: R501/R502: 4.7k to 3V3. Start at 100kHz; total bus C <= 240pF. External parallel pull-ups require recalculation.

g.text: BMI088 Rev1.9 p52/53: accel SDO1=3V3 (0x19), gyro SDO2=GND (0x68), PS=3V3 selects I2C, CSB2 pin5 is DNC in I2C mode, CSB1 pin14=3V3. Pin 2 is GND despite its NC name. C319/C320 are the local 100nF for VDD/VDDIO.
